# godot_hidden.ps1 - run a WINDOWED Godot job without it popping up on the operator's screen.
#
# Operator, 2026-09-23: "can you make the windows that the agents open do not pop and run
# silently in the background". Render tools cannot run --headless (no GPU output), and Godot
# CLAMPS both `--position` and DisplayServer.window_set_position() back onto a visible monitor
# (measured: --position 20000,20000 landed at 1486,761; a script move to -32000 read back 0,0).
# So the hiding is done from OUTSIDE: start Godot, wait for its window, then Win32 SetWindowPos
# it to -32000,-32000 (off every monitor, NOT minimized - a minimized Godot stops drawing, so
# captures would come out empty), no activation, and drop its taskbar button.

# the window titled "... (DEBUG)" still reached the screen. Two holes: (1) the watch loop ran a

# every 15 ms against a cached pid list and re-hides ANY visible window of the job whose left

#

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

Report to Claude / operator. Everything below is committed on `ziva/playtest` and pushed.

## What landed

**1) WIP #2 finished — but not as the WIP had it.**
The stance-radius hypothesis (`STANCE_UNPLANT_M` 8 cm) was **measured first and disproved**:

| census, seed 95501, 40 s, as_game | `off=stance_unplant` (red) | 8 cm stance radius |
|---|---|---|
| plants over the 2 cm gate | 34 / 56 | 32 / 69 |
| flicker (plants < 3 frames) | 11 | 35 |
| `planted_skate` a/b frames | 169 / 152 | **170 / 180 (worse)** |

A tighter release radius makes the foot let go *more often* and every release is a pop. Reverted; the dead end is recorded in `research/S263_stance_unplant_disproved.gd` (the retired test moved out of `tests/`).

**The real defect, found with new instrumentation** (`fight_motion_probe.gd legtrace=b0`, which prints per frame the pin, the lock's `shown`, the clip's own toe, the toe it actually got via the live bone chain *and* Godot's cached pose, the root's move, and the same read at the end of the room's pass):
the pin holds (pin_moved 0.0 mm, the clip's toe **on** the pin) and the root stands still, yet the drawn toe walked 0.9 → 25.0 → 14.7 mm off its pin over one `boxing_cross`→`idle` plant. The writer is the AnimationPlayers being stepped again *after* the lock; S258's re-pin only ran when the **root** moved, so nothing put the foot back.

Fix: `FightStagePlayer.repin_needed` + switch `foot_repin` (ON), used by `relock_feet_after_root`; plus released legs are erased from `_lock_shown_world` so a swing foot is never dragged back to a stale pin.
**Red → after:** over-gate **34/56 → 13/56**, mean 42.4 → 32.6 mm, p95 87.3 → 74.9 mm, idle 22/25 → 8/25, `planted_skate` 169/152 → 159/140. Commit **752c6f1a**.
Still open in #2: the remaining failures are pins that **jump** (pin_step 95–1117 mm, `seeds=0`) — the foot teleports to the new clip's stance at a take change and the plant never closes.

My `repin_needed`/`foot_repin` and Claude's `cap_wrist`/`GUARD_WRIST_BEND_MAX_DEG 50`/`ROLL 35` (+ `_hand_axis`, applied in `_guard_ik_arm`) all coexist and are active (still shows `R_wrist_bend_deg` 50.8/53.4, i.e. the cap is doing work). The wrist cap was not touched.

**3) #1 join at the source — 7c78bfc1.** The source is a **table gap**: `anim_transitions.json` has no row for `boxing_catch → boxing_jab` (`_review_class` has no "catch" → UNKNOWN) nor `BODY_SHOT → JAB`; `ReviewInertia.rule` returns `{}` and an empty row meant `_review_duration = 0` — **no join at all, a hard cut**. 112 of 122 clip switches were over the gate.
Fix: `default_row` + `REVIEW_DEFAULT_JOIN_S` (0.10 s), switch `join_default` (ON, `off=join_default` = red arm); STAGGER/KNOCKDOWN/GET_UP keep their cuts, an authored row always wins, and each default use still logs `INERTIAL_JOINS default_join=… from=… to=… take=…` so the row to author is visible.
**Red → after (seed 94301):** clip's own teleport 496.8 → 357.8 mm; in-run layer pop 311.7 → 118.3 mm; paired excess 193.6 → 118.9 mm; `POP_LAG` 306.3 → 189.3 mm; `POP_SLIP` 46.5 mm unchanged.

**The 5 mm gate is not reached, and the arithmetic says no join fix can reach it**: `POP_SLIP` (the layer's own release) is bounded by `GUARD_IK_SLEW_M` = **40 mm/frame** while the gate is 5 mm, and the corrections being given up are **100–300 mm** (`hold_m` on the ramps). A ≤5 mm/frame hand-over of a 200 mm correction takes ~40 frames (1.3 s). That is a design call, not a bug I can code around: lower the S263 slew cap (slower, more laggy hand-over) **or** hold the pin until the clip's own retraction brings the hand home (minimum added motion, longer visible pin). **Instrument finding you should know about:** `guard_pop_analysis.gd`'s paired `excess_mm` was reading two different fights. ## #4's fix, built and measured: by **translation**, per the brief's own words

The brief says the head should use *"the head-**translated** position with a torso-facing basis"* — and that is exactly the distinction my first attempt missed. Rotating the head bone cannot move the `neck → head-origin` segment (a bone's own rotation does not move its own origin — that's why the rotation ran 2.53 → 2.52 → 2.53). Translating the head bone's origin **can**.

`_head_level_pass` now moves the head along the chest's own forward/up plane until the segment sits at a quarter of the torso's pitch, against the style's own head home (read on the first frame the pass runs — a boxing stance already leans — and followed slowly so the chin tuck survives). Two details earned by measurement:

- **It has to live in the room's final-pose hook** (`finish_hand_frame`, beside `relock_feet_after_root`), not just the pass chain — the same lesson #2 taught: the AnimationPlayers step again after a pass and erase a translation.
- **The slew matters**: 12 mm/frame was too slow where it counts (the fast frames). 25 mm/frame is committed.

| `head_max_deg` (the extreme head tip from vertical) | 104.6 | **81.6** (−22%) |

func run() -> void:
	root.size = Vector2i(1920, 1080)
	var out: String = _arg("out", "")
	if out.is_empty():
		push_error("out=<abs dir> required")
		quit(1)
		return
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(out)
	var a: Dictionary = Live.demo_fighter("a", "boxing")
	var b: Dictionary = Live.demo_fighter("b", "boxing")
	(a["stats"] as Dictionary)["guard"] = 25.0
	(b["stats"] as Dictionary)["guard"] = 85.0
	## S262 GUARD IK: style=<GuardPose style> puts both boxers in that guard (the 5-style comparison sheet).
	var style_a: String = _arg("style_a", _arg("style", ""))
	var style_b: String = _arg("style_b", _arg("style", ""))
	if not style_a.is_empty():
		a["guard_style"] = style_a
	if not style_b.is_empty():
		b["guard_style"] = style_b
	var live: Node3D = (load("res://scenes/FightWorldLive.tscn") as PackedScene).instantiate()
	var options := {"fighter_a": a, "fighter_b": b, "discipline": "boxing", "seed": 94301, "walkout": false, "hit_cam": false}
	## S264: `off=a,b` turns room switches OFF for an A/B (the same convention as tools/fight_motion_probe.gd), so the guard
	## pop pair can be re-measured against the red arm of the switch it just changed.
	for sw in _arg("off", "").split(",", false):
		options[sw.strip_edges()] = false
	if _arg("attributes", "1") == "0":
		options["attributes"] = false
	live.configure(options)
	root.add_child(live)
	if not live.setup():
		push_error("setup failed")
		quit(1)
		return
	live.set_process(false)
